description: Na₂MgH₈(SO₆)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.54 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-67°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.10 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-64°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.49 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two H atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom.
